settings.location: Tamil Nadu & Destination Weddings (Chennai, Madurai, Coimbatore, Tirunelveli, Bengaluru)
settings.about_bio: At AK Bridals, we specialize in high-definition bridal transformations, authentic organic mehndi, handcrafted aari silk embroidery, and traditional muhurtham saree pleating.

services.name: Muhurtham Bridal Makeup
services.desc: Flawless HD airbrush and traditional bridal makeover with 24hr waterproof finish, customized for your skin tone and event lighting.

services.name: Reception Glam Makeup
services.desc: Modern, glowing evening transformation with shimmering eye accents and contemporary styling for reception & sangeet.

services.name: Royal Muhurtham & Reception Combo
services.desc: Complete bridal look package covering Muhurtham ceremony and Reception transformation with saree draping and hair jadai.

services.name: Bridal Organic Mehndi
services.desc: Intricate traditional and modern bridal henna using 100% pure organic herbal cones for deep maroon and long-lasting stain.

services.name: Handcrafted Aari Silk Blouse
services.desc: Custom bridal blouse designing with gold zari, cutdana, pearls, and 3D zardozi embroidery handcrafted to match your wedding saree.

services.name: Hair Styling & Saree Draping
services.desc: Traditional poola jada, flower veni setting, modern reception messy buns, and box-pleated Kanchipuram silk saree draping.

services.name: Professional Bridal Academy Course
services.desc: Comprehensive hands-on bridal certification masterclass covering skin anatomy, color correction, HD airbrush, and live model practice.

reviews.name: Keerthana Rajesh
reviews.comment: AK Bridals made my wedding day truly magical! The HD airbrush makeup stayed completely fresh, sweat-proof, and glowing from 5 AM Muhurtham until the evening rituals.

reviews.name: Soundarya Manoharan
reviews.comment: The organic henna was breathtaking! The bridal peacock and temple motifs were so sharp and intricate. The color developed into an intense dark maroon stain that lasted over two weeks.

reviews.name: Divya Venkatesh
reviews.comment: Superb zardozi needlework and gold zari detailing on my wedding saree blouse. The precision tailoring fit was 100% flawless and perfectly matched my antique bridal jewelry.

reviews.name: Sangeetha Ramesh
reviews.comment: The traditional poola jada floral setting and box-pleated Kanchipuram silk saree draping was immaculate. It stayed perfectly in place through all wedding rituals with zero discomfort.

reviews.name: Aarthi Subramanian
reviews.comment: Booked AK Bridals for both my Muhurtham and Reception. Loved how they gave two completely distinct looks — pure traditional muhurtham bride for morning and glamorous dewy glow for night!

reviews.name: Janani Vijay
reviews.comment: Attended the bridal masterclass. Excellent practical training with live models and clear product guidance. Gave me immense confidence to take on bridal makeup bookings independently.
